title: Small and Light Duty
text:
Small and Light Duty. Pros: small; plug in and it turns on; 3 sizes of nozzles; travel plug in included.
Cons: very light duty; stopped working after 10 minutes to cool down; nozzles will only fit pump outlets that are greater than a third of an inch.
However, very good seller to work with.
